componentNotes.lib/mappingTable.json: GENERATED, not authored. The repository’s own scripts/generateMappingTable.js (present at this commit) fetches http://www.unicode.org/Public/idna/latest/IdnaMappingTable.txt and reduces it to code-point ranges with their IDNA status, which is why the file is absent from the source tree. It is therefore DERIVED FROM UNICODE CONSORTIUM DATA, which carries its own terms (the Unicode License Agreement for Data Files and Software) that neither this package nor its repository mentions. The MIT grant recorded here covers tr46’s own code and is separately proven by the matching runtime files; it makes no claim about this table. Measured 2026-09-10; tr46 and whatwg-url are ABSENT from the built client bundle, so this concerns code we run rather than code we distribute to browsers.
